notes: Final amendment to an issuer tender offer (SC TO-I/A) by MacKenzie Realty Capital, Inc. for its common stock at a fixed $6 per share. fund_type is 'unknown': the excerpt does not say what kind of entity the filer is. The filing is internally inconsistent: the offer paragraph describes the Offer as to purchase 58,897.7444 shares at $6, the fee note assumes the purchase of 400,000 Shares, and the results paragraph says the Company 'received and accepted a total of approximately 13,303,521.4954 Shares' while also saying it purchased 0.4% of outstanding Shares and will pay approximately $353,386.47 (which at $6 implies about 58,898 shares, an arithmetic inference not used). size_shares uses the 400,000 fee-basis maximum; shares_tendered/shares_accepted use the literal 13,303,521.4954 statement, which looks erroneous. No ticker (CUSIP N/A), no expiration date, proration, conditions or reason for the offer are stated. commencement_date is taken from the Offer to Purchase date (March 19, 2021, also the date the original SC TO-I was filed). The signature is dated April 23, 2022, apparently a typo for 2021.
